name: employee-leave-management-system
description: Employee Leave Management System with Auth, Role-based Access, and File Uploads

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); try { if(!fs.existsSync('dist') && fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});} } catch(e){}"
